nodes.role: Electron main process and IPC host. Boots the BrowserWindow, wires every subsystem together and registers ~115 ipcMain handlers that the renderer calls through the preload bridge.
constraints: 4400 lines — the single largest file in the repo and the de-facto composition root.
Carries an inline duplicate of the runtime-callback logic that also lives in coreCallbacks.js; the code itself flags the duplication at main.js:747 and main.js:1031.
Not covered directly by any test file; behaviour is tested through the extracted src/main/* modules.
evidence: .ombutocode/src/main.js:747 comment 'coreCallbacks.js for the sibling copy of this block'

nodes.role: contextBridge sandbox boundary. Exposes a channel-filtered window.electron.ipcRenderer (send / on / invoke) to the renderer; the only path from UI code into the main process.
constraints: All renderer-to-main traffic must pass through the allowed-channel lists declared in this file; a new IPC channel is inert until it is listed here.

nodes.role: Vue 3 application shell: bootstrap (main.js), the App.vue tab/board host, the hash-history router, the logger plugin and shared renderer utilities (dropbox, notification sound, skills, requirements matrix, terminal paste).
constraints: Router is hash-history with only 3 routes; the primary navigation model is in-App.vue tab switching rather than routing.
Grouped files: router/index.js, plugins/logger.js, utils/{dropbox,dropbox.new,logger,notificationSound,requirementsMatrix,skills,terminalPaste}.js

nodes.role: Pinia state layer (12 stores). Each store owns one IPC-backed domain — backlog, archive, epics, agents, agent tools, logs, requests, artifacts, tree, settings, boards, UI — and is the only place the UI issues invoke() calls.
constraints: Grouped files: agentStore, agentToolsStore, archiveStore, artifactStore, backlogStore, boardStore, epicStore, logsStore, requestsStore, settingsStore, treeStore, uiStore.
boardStore and uiStore hold local-only state and issue no IPC calls.

nodes.role: Screen and widget layer (55 files): 21 views (dashboard, diagrams, requirements, git, settings, skills, tree, validate) plus 34 components (kanban board, backlog/archive/epics tables, the Plan* wizard screens, run summary and diff dialogs, workspace and automation panels).
constraints: UI tests assert against the .vue source text rather than a mounted component; they are wiring checks, not render tests.
components/ReviewCodeMapView.vue is untracked in git at this commit and is therefore excluded from the module fingerprint.

nodes.role: The orchestration core. A dependency-injected factory (createScheduler) that ticks a queue: gates tickets on dependencies and epic readiness, prepares worktrees or eval trial merges, dispatches runs to the agent runtime under concurrency/cooldown/budget limits, and parses provider rate-limit pauses out of run output.
constraints: Takes all collaborators via the deps object (readBacklogData, agentRuntime, createTicketWorktree, ...), so tests substitute fakes without touching git or child processes.
Reentrancy-guarded: dispatching / dispatchQueued flags make a nested dispatch() re-run processQueue in the same do-while loop instead of recursing.
Only picks up tickets with status todo and an explicit agent assignee; epic gating reads docs/Epics from disk on every tick.

nodes.role: Scheduler helpers: rolling usage-window and auto-pause state persistence (windowTracker), scheduler event logging into the logs database (schedulerLogger + schedulerLogEvents), and epic markdown parsing that builds the epic readiness gate (epicReader).
constraints: Grouped files: windowTracker.js, schedulerLogger.js, schedulerLogEvents.js, epicReader.js.
windowTracker state is a JSON file on disk, not a database row — it survives restarts and carries scheduler_running.

nodes.role: Spawns and supervises external coding-agent CLI processes. Renders per-tool command templates from codingagents.yml, launches them via child_process, tracks live runs by ticket and run id, and streams output back through the runtime callbacks.
constraints: Tool roster, concurrency caps, cooldowns, budgets and model ids are data in .ombutocode/codingagents/codingagents.yml — adding an agent is a config change, not a code change.
resolveKimiTemplateConfig is a per-provider special case alongside the generic resolveAgentTemplateConfig.
Grouped file: .ombutocode/codingagents/codingagents.yml

nodes.role: The onRunStarted / onRunUpdated / onRunFinished handler set. Turns a finished agent run into ticket state: resolves the next status, commits the worktree, squash-merges the ticket branch, records the merge commit, kicks off run summarisation and tears the worktree down.
constraints: Consumed only by headless-cli at this commit; the Electron main process runs its own inline copy of the same logic (see main.js:747, main.js:1031). The two must be kept in step by hand.

nodes.role: Post-run interpretation and housekeeping. Decides the ticket status, eval outcome and test outcome implied by a finished run, extracts text and impl/test markers from stream-json output, groups run logs into phases and drives the LLM run-summary prompt; also purges stale run output and cleans up status transitions.
constraints: Grouped files: runLifecycle.js, runSummary.js, runOutputCleanup.js, statusTransitionCleanup.js.
runSummary applies HEAD_BUDGET_CHARS / TAIL_BUDGET_CHARS truncation before prompting, so very long transcripts are summarised from the ends only.
statusTransitionCleanup reaches into worktreeManager to remove worktrees left behind by a status change.

nodes.role: Owns every git worktree operation for ticket isolation: create/remove a per-ticket worktree and branch, prepare and clean up eval trial merges, rebase on conflict, commit worktree changes and squash-merge the ticket branch back to main. Also verifies the installed git supports what it needs.
constraints: unlinkNodeModulesLinks is exported purely so tests can pin the junction guard — without it a worktree teardown can wipe node_modules in the main repo (comment at worktreeManager.js:1332).
Grouped file: gitVersionCheck.js.
Copies .ombutocode/data/ombutocode.db into the worktree so agents see the backlog (worktreeManager.js:994).

nodes.role: Read-only git inspection for the UI: resolves a ticket's merge commit, lists changed files from name-status/numstat, returns per-file diffs with a binary and size guard, and records the merge commit on the ticket. versionService adds per-file history and blob-at-commit lookups via simple-git.
constraints: assertSafeRepoPath is a path-traversal guard on every repo-relative argument; MAX_INLINE_FILE_BYTES caps what is streamed to the renderer.
Grouped file: versionService.js (uses simple-git, unlike gitDiffService which shells out directly).

nodes.role: Ticket-level business rules above the raw database: read the backlog, change ticket status, delete, move to archive, and resolve dependency satisfaction. Also drafts ad-hoc tickets by prompting a coding agent, and writes ticket markdown files to disk.
constraints: Database handles are injected at boot via setArchiveDb / setBacklogDb rather than imported, so this module has no static dependency on persistence-db.
Grouped files: adHocTickets.js, ticketFileManager.js.
adHocTickets shells out to a coding-agent CLI with a hard DEFAULT_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS and clamps prompts to MAX_PROMPT_CHARS.

nodes.role: The sql.js persistence layer. ombutocodeDb is the facade over four physical SQLite files — backlog_tickets (ombutocode.db), archived tickets (archive.db), scheduler_logs (logs.db) and requests (requests.db) — plus jobManager's backup_job / backup_run / exclusion_rule tables.
constraints: sql.js keeps the whole database in memory and must be explicitly written back to the .db file — there is no incremental on-disk write.
backlog_tickets in .ombutocode/data/ombutocode.db is the canonical task list per CLAUDE.md; docs/Epics markdown is secondary.
archiveDb.js:618 and backlogDb.js:646 lazily require js-yaml for the legacy YAML migration path.
Grouped files: ombutocodeDb.js, backlogDb.js, archiveDb.js, logsDb.js, requestsDb.js, jobManager.js. Data files: .ombutocode/data/{ombutocode,archive,logs,requests}.db

nodes.role: Requirements-as-artifacts store. artifactDb holds artifacts and id counters, artifactService adds gray-matter frontmatter parsing, hierarchy validation and index rebuilds, and treeService derives the requirement tree, ancestors/descendants, breadcrumbs and coverage reports.
entrypoints: artifactService.js:471 list / get / create / update / archive / nextId / rebuildIndex / validateHierarchyRules
treeService.js:209 buildTree / ancestors / descendants / children / breadcrumb / coverageReport / componentSummary
artifactDb.js:294 open / insertArtifact / updateArtifact / listArtifacts / getNextId / rebuildCounters
constraints: Grouped files: artifactDb.js, artifactService.js, treeService.js, planCoreUtilities.js.
No dedicated test file in .ombutocode/src/test at this commit — the artifact and tree services are untested.

nodes.role: Everything that touches the docs/ workspace on disk: scanning and CRUD over documents, mockups, use cases and class diagrams (fileTreeService); chokidar watching that re-indexes artifacts on change (fileWatcher); .ombutocode structure scaffolding (projectInit) and legacy layout migration (projectMigration); shared YAML/config helpers (coreUtilities).
entrypoints: fileTreeService.js:297 init / scan / readFile / writeFile / scanMockups / scanUseCases / scanClassDiagrams
constraints: fileWatcher.js is not required by main.js, headless.js or any other module at this commit — it is currently dead code (see the unknown edge to electron-main).
Grouped files: fileTreeService.js, fileWatcher.js, projectInit.js, projectMigration.js, coreUtilities.js.

nodes.role: Electron-free entrypoint that runs the same scheduler loop from a terminal or CI. Substitutes a file-backed settings store for electron-store and composes the scheduler, agent runtime and runtime callbacks directly.
constraints: Requires modules lazily inside the boot function so a partially initialised project fails with a clear message rather than at import time.
This is the only consumer of coreCallbacks.js — the Electron path duplicates that logic inline.
Grouped file: headlessSettings.js.

nodes.role: DropSync — the product application being built in this repo. A separate small Electron/Vue app (backup jobs, job config, backup logs) with its own main process, preload bridge and 4-route router.
constraints: Reaches across the workbench boundary: src/main/index.js:3 requires .ombutocode/src/src/main/jobManager, so the product app's job storage is the workbench's module.
No tests at this commit.
Grouped files: src/main/{index,logsManager}.js, src/preload/index.js, src/renderer/**, scripts/dev.js.

nodes.role: External dependency: the coding-agent command-line tools (claude, codex, and the other configured providers) spawned as child processes to actually perform ticket work inside a worktree.
constraints: Each tool declares rolling_window_hours, max_concurrent, cooldown_minutes and budget_limit; the scheduler enforces those, the CLI does not.
Availability is environmental — the binary must be on PATH; the repo only holds the invocation template.

nodes.role: External dependency: the git repository itself. Backs ticket isolation (worktrees and per-ticket branches), the merge-back path, and every diff and file-history view in the UI.
constraints: A minimum git version is required for the worktree flags used; gitVersionCheck.checkGitVersionSupport gates startup on it.
On Windows, worktrees use directory junctions for node_modules — worktreeManager guards teardown so the main repo's node_modules is not removed.

flows.trigger: A ticket reaches status todo with an assigned agent and the scheduler ticks (scheduler.js:974 dispatch → scheduler.js:1089 processQueue).
flows.outcome: The agent runs inside an isolated git worktree; on completion the run is classified, the ticket branch is committed and squash-merged, the worktree is torn down and the ticket's new status is persisted to backlog_tickets.

flows.trigger: The user acts in the Vue UI — opening the backlog, starting the scheduler, editing settings.
flows.outcome: A Pinia store issues a channel-filtered invoke(), the main process handler reads or writes SQLite, and the resolved value flows back into store state that re-renders the shell.

flows.trigger: A ticket in review is selected for evaluation, so the scheduler must prove the branch merges before spending an agent run (scheduler.js:1276).
flows.outcome: On a clean trial merge the eval agent runs against the merged tree; on conflict the scheduler retries once after a rebase, then resets the ticket to todo with state merge_failed and an explanatory note (main.js:1289-1317).

flows.trigger: A ticket's branch is squash-merged successfully and run summarisation is enabled (coreCallbacks deps.startRunSummary).
flows.outcome: Phase transcripts are grouped and head/tail-truncated into a summary prompt, an agent CLI produces the summary, the parsed result is stored and the run summary dialog renders it.

flows.trigger: The user opens the changes or merge view for a completed ticket.
flows.outcome: The ticket's merge commit is resolved, changed files come back from name-status/numstat and each file diff is streamed to the CodeMirror merge view under the binary and size guards.

flows.trigger: npm run headless is invoked outside Electron (terminal or CI).
flows.outcome: A file-backed settings store replaces electron-store and the identical scheduler loop drives tickets to completion with no window and no renderer.
